[EN] I have news from the argon front!
[ES] ¡Tengo noticias del frente argón!

[EN] The argons are retreating from Tirkai Forest!
[ES] ¡Los argones se están retirando del Tirkai Forest!

[EN] I'll leave for Pathfinder Post immediately to let them know.
[ES] Partiré hacia Pathfinder Post de inmediato para avisarles.
